name: Batch 19 · Bright sparks
status: Published to Spotify and atomically imported to hosted Playlist Lab; exact order, pending queues and old feedback preservation verified. Candidates are not party approvals.

selection_policy.room_brief: Upbeat, fun, hopeful, loving, bouncy, melodic and sexy. No acid/techno or sad/negative central narratives; avoid chart-pop-led selection.
selection_policy.host_correction: Grove 18 missed because it was too bland or low energy, October 29.
selection_policy.batch_size_decision: 25 focused calibration candidates after two consecutive 0/50 rounds; reduce weak comparisons while testing the energy correction.
selection_policy.source: Suitable current Likes first; targeted discovery previously authorized.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Sourced lyric context, catalog descriptors and musical impact hypotheses are separate; no full listening claimed.
selection_policy.allocation: 11 vocal punch / eight rhythmic indie and dance-punk / six big melodic/electronic hooks. Batch 18's 40/10 allocation was provisional for that round.
